index_schema.route_map_shape: routes is an object that maps each route name to an ordered list of file paths; see route_legend for each route name's purpose.

file_entry_field_legend.path: archive-relative file path for this entry
file_entry_field_legend.section: top-level bucket or containing docs section used in the human index
file_entry_field_legend.title: human-readable title for the file
file_entry_field_legend.status: archive lifecycle / routing status; see status_legend for the human-front-door / machine-front-door split as well as doctrine and integrity roles
file_entry_field_legend.claim_kind: burden class for the file; see claim_kind_legend
file_entry_field_legend.canonical_anchor: true only when this file is a canonical governing anchor for a recurring question cluster
file_entry_field_legend.route_refs: list of canonical route names from routes that include this file, are rendered directly by this file, are carried directly by this file as an authoritative route map, or are otherwise directly relied on by this file; empty means no local route linkage is asserted

index_schema.route_ref_semantics: route_refs names the canonical route arrays in routes that this file either participates in directly, renders directly as a route-bearing navigation surface, carries directly as an authoritative route-map surface, or directly relies on; it is a local cross-reference, not a separate routing surface.
index_schema.front_door_operator_kit_semantics: front_door_operator_kit names the compact reusable operator blocks carried locally by the canonical direct-answer note; display_order is the operator-listing order exposed at the front door, while operating_sequence is the default order for using the kit in live front-door reasoning. local_ref and section_slug let later tools land on the exact local operator section in home instead of inferring section targets from prose. decision_question is the one-line front-door prompt each operator is supposed to answer. operator_role says whether the block is the kit's meta-sequence, a substantive screen, a naming block, the opacity-burden block, the status block, or the opening-package router. output_kind says what compact answer shape the block is supposed to emit into the next front-door step. default_inputs says what compact context or prior reads the block should usually have in hand before it emits that answer. A meta_sequence block may appear in display_order without repeating inside operating_sequence as another substantive screen. If a top-level human entry surface enumerates the kit, it should either mirror display_order or explicitly say that it is narrating operating_sequence instead.

front_door_operator_role_legend.meta_sequence: orders use of the rest of the kit rather than screening the case directly
front_door_operator_role_legend.screen: tests one substantive surface of the case before comfort or certification is named
front_door_operator_role_legend.naming: chooses which compact target-family label or ideal-family answer to state first
front_door_operator_role_legend.burden: sets how opacity or proof debt should change comfort and certification
front_door_operator_role_legend.status: names the case's current compact verdict
front_door_operator_role_legend.routing: routes the case from the diagnosed breach toward the opening package

front_door_operator_output_kind_legend.sequence: ordered next-step list for using the rest of the kit
front_door_operator_output_kind_legend.bundle_pass_read: simultaneous pass / fail read across the ideal-order bundle
front_door_operator_output_kind_legend.composition_read: compact read on what kind of wealth, title, control, or public counterweight is widening
front_door_operator_output_kind_legend.group_closure_read: compact read on whether historically subordinated groups are reaching and keeping the gains on civic-equal terms
front_door_operator_output_kind_legend.proof_surface_read: compact five-surface read on whether claimed movement is real rather than flattering
front_door_operator_output_kind_legend.certification_cap: compact rule for how opacity or proof debt should cap comfort or certification

index_schema.front_door_operator_input_semantics: default_inputs names the minimum upstream context or prior reads the front-door should usually have in hand before asking an operator for its compact answer. Inputs may name case_context, an output_kind emitted by an earlier operator in the default operating sequence, or an established case-work read imported from outside the kit.

front_door_operator_input_kind_legend.case_context: ordinary case facts, distribution snapshot, or country context being assessed at the front door
front_door_operator_input_kind_legend.target_family_label: compact target-family naming answer emitted by the envelope-naming block
front_door_operator_input_kind_legend.bundle_pass_read: simultaneous pass / fail read emitted by the pass-bundle block
front_door_operator_input_kind_legend.composition_read: composition screen read emitted by the composition block
front_door_operator_input_kind_legend.group_closure_read: excluded-group screen read emitted by the group-screen block
front_door_operator_input_kind_legend.proof_surface_read: five-surface movement read emitted by the proof panel
front_door_operator_input_kind_legend.certification_cap: opacity-burden cap emitted by the opacity-default block
front_door_operator_input_kind_legend.compact_verdict: four-state verdict emitted by the verdict strip
front_door_operator_input_kind_legend.dominant_breach_read: live diagnosis of the dominant breach imported from case-work or an equivalent compact read
front_door_operator_input_kind_legend.fastest_washout_read: live diagnosis of the fastest washout channel imported from case-work or an equivalent compact read

index_schema.file_catalog_order_semantics: files is a section-grouped archive inventory. For the top-level entry and integrity surfaces, order should usually present the declared human entry notes in the same sequence as entry_surfaces.human_sequence, then the machine entry surface, then receipt / ledger / source / manifest artifacts unless a different sort is stated explicitly.

status_legend.human_front_door: top-level human entry surface used to enter the archive quickly
status_legend.machine_front_door: authoritative top-level machine entry surface or machine routing map used to enter the archive quickly
status_legend.live_anchor: canonical doctrine note for a recurring question cluster
status_legend.active_bridge: short route or operator note that connects anchors to a narrower job
status_legend.stable_support: supporting note that deepens or stabilises one part of the archive
status_legend.question_ledger: open-question or research-backlog surface rather than live doctrine
status_legend.integrity_artifact: revision or packaging artifact rather than substantive doctrine

claim_kind_legend.navigation_surface: front-door or routing surface that helps readers or tools enter the archive
claim_kind_legend.constitutional_doctrine: live moral or institutional doctrine about acceptable or unacceptable wealth orders
claim_kind_legend.program_rule: program, measurement, case-work, routing, or implementation rule used to move from doctrine to action
claim_kind_legend.archive_governance: rule for how the archive itself grows, routes, compresses, repairs, or governs revisions
claim_kind_legend.source_ledger: source-map or citation-ledger surface rather than live doctrine
claim_kind_legend.question_ledger: open-question or research-backlog surface rather than settled archive doctrine
claim_kind_legend.integrity_artifact: revision or packaging artifact whose burden is exact bundle truth and agreement

route_legend.direct_answer: shortest doctrinal and program route for answering the archive's main question
route_legend.implementation_core: compact route from direct answer into rail-weighted implementation realism and transition design
route_legend.core_spine: full canonical route from moral diagnosis through targets, verdicts, program design, case work, measurement, prevention/response, and mode choice
route_legend.case_work_core: canonical route for applying the archive to a live case, comparing cases, and promoting or parking cross-case patterns
route_legend.archive_governance_core: canonical route for how the archive itself grows, routes, compresses, revises, and resolves conflicts
route_legend.source_governance_core: canonical route for source function, refresh cadence, compression discipline, and ledger surfaces
route_legend.prevention_response: compact route from target choice into posture selection, non-deferrable duties, and transition ordering
route_legend.certification_core: compact route from target choice into measurement, verdict, and posture placement

direct_answer.meaning: shortest doctrinal and program route for answering the archive's main question
direct_answer.use_when: use when the live question is still mainly what target family and first package make sense

implementation_core.meaning: compact route from direct answer into rail-weighted implementation realism and transition design
implementation_core.use_when: use when the live question has shifted to how the chosen package becomes governable, durable, and administratively real

prevention_response.meaning: compact route from target choice into posture selection, non-deferrable duties, and transition ordering
prevention_response.use_when: use when the live question has shifted to which governing posture fits the case and what becomes non-deferrable under it

certification_core.meaning: compact route from target choice into measurement, verdict, and posture placement
certification_core.use_when: use when the live question has shifted to whether a case really earns near-ideal, provisional near-pass, or correction-required language, what evidence would have to move that call, and whether the reading has survived a durability window rather than one friendly moment

compact_named_route_semantics: compact_named_routes hoists the archive's four short preferred named routes as a self-contained short-route surface: each object carries the route name, one-line meaning, a compact use_when cue, the ordered file array itself, and a canonical route_ref back into the fuller routes map so later readers and tools can land on the shortest answer path, the compact implementation-realism continuation, the shortest posture-choice continuation, or the shortest certification continuation without an extra traversal just to recover the file order or infer the route-choice threshold from front-door prose alone.
entry_surface_semantics: entry_surfaces names the compact default landing map for top-level archive entry. human_default and machine_default name the first file each reader type should usually open, human_sequence and machine_sequence name the preferred top-level fallback order by reader type and should respect the declared role split rather than placing the revision-aware release shell ahead of a better-targeted answer or browsing surface; once machine entry is explicitly separated, human_sequence should remain human-only. current_revision_receipt names the exact current-bundle receipt surface, recent_revision_ledger names the thin retained revision-memory ledger, and source_ledgers name the source-map surfaces.
revision_memory_surface_semantics: revision_memory_surfaces names the distinct revision-memory roles: recent_revision_ledger is the thin latest-first accumulating revision ledger, while current_revision_receipt is the exact full receipt for the current bundle only.

revision_memory_scope.recent_revision_ledger_basis: reconstructed from nearby bundle receipts at rev0211 build time, bundle-self-read audited through rev0235, then extended revision-by-revision to the current bundle

revision_memory_scope_semantics: authoritative retained-ledger summary: retained start and end revisions, continuity, entry count, current-revision inclusion, read order, short provenance basis, and where older history lives.

chronology_ordering.bundle_clock_basis: local New York wall clock in YYYY.MM.DD.HH.MM
chronology_ordering.wall_clock_role: orientation aid only; does not override canonical revision sequence

known_anomalies.detail: bundle clock string is later than surrounding retained history; canonical order remains revision number
bundle clock `2026.03.25.19.03` is earlier than superseded rev0274 `2026.03.25.19.08`; canonical order remains revision number

chronology_ordering_semantics: chronology_ordering names the compact rules readers and tools should use when comparing revisions: canonical order is revision number, wall-clock strings are orientation aids only, and any known chronology anomalies should be disclosed both in `known_anomalies` here and in CHANGELOG.md plus REVISION-RECEIPT.json rather than inferred from filenames.

machine_front_door.purpose: machine entry surface: read entry_surfaces for landing order, compact_named_routes for the four short preferred routes and their use_when cues, then machine_front_door refs for fuller routing, file metadata, revision-memory surfaces, chronology ordering, and the front-door operator kit.
machine_front_door.ref_syntax_semantics: Every *_ref field in machine_front_door is an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer rooted at ARCHIVE_INDEX.json itself. Top-level targets therefore begin with /, and nested targets use slash-separated path segments rather than dotted names.

front_door_operator_kit.operator_id_semantics: operator_id mirrors the stable operator key inside each operator object so extracted or flattened operator records remain self-identifying outside the enclosing operators map.

use_order.heading: Smallest front-door use order
use_order.purpose: compact sequence note for using the target family, proof, status, and first-package screens together
use_order.decision_question: In what order should the archive use the front-door blocks before it names a package?

breach_to_package_kernel.heading: Smallest reusable breach-to-package map
breach_to_package_kernel.purpose: compact first-package map from dominant breach to the opening lane mix
breach_to_package_kernel.decision_question: Given the dominant breach and fastest washout, what opening lane mix should the archive route first?

pass_bundle.heading: Ideal-order pass bundle
pass_bundle.purpose: simultaneous constitutional pass conditions for near-ideal certification
pass_bundle.decision_question: Does the case actually satisfy the six simultaneous pass conditions for near-ideal certification?

composition_check.heading: Smallest anti-flattery composition check
composition_check.purpose: screen on what kind of wealth, title, control, or public counterweight is actually widening
composition_check.decision_question: What kind of wealth, title, control, or public counterweight is actually widening here?

group_screen.heading: Excluded-group anti-averaging screen
group_screen.purpose: screen on whether historically subordinated groups are reaching and keeping the gains on civic-equal terms
group_screen.decision_question: Are historically subordinated groups reaching and keeping the gains on anything like civic-equal terms?

envelope_naming_rule.heading: How to name the ideal family
envelope_naming_rule.purpose: default-first rule for naming the acceptable target family and its earned off-center envelopes
envelope_naming_rule.decision_question: Which target family should the archive name first here: the center or an earned off-center envelope?

proof_panel.heading: Smallest live proof panel
proof_panel.purpose: five-surface test for whether claimed movement is real rather than flattering
proof_panel.decision_question: Across the five live proof surfaces, is the claimed movement real rather than flattering?

opacity_default.heading: Smallest proof-debt default under opacity
opacity_default.purpose: asymmetry rule that hardens certification more than lower-regret correction under missing visibility
opacity_default.decision_question: What should missing controller, transfer, valuation, or influence visibility do to certification and correction?

verdict_strip.heading: Smallest verdict strip
verdict_strip.purpose: compressed four-state status readout used before routing the opening package
verdict_strip.decision_question: Which compact verdict does the case currently earn: still failing, correction-required, provisional near-pass, or near-ideal / acceptable?

front_door_operator_kit.local_heading_order_semantics: local_heading_order names the actual order in which the named operator sections appear in the kit's home note. It may differ from operating_sequence, but if it differs from display_order the entry surfaces should say so explicitly.
front_door_operator_kit.default_input_source_semantics: default_input_sources maps each default_input tag to the operator that usually emits it or to external_context when the input comes from the live case rather than another front-door block.
